# `gabor_bursts`

the bursts of each channel matched by unit-energy Gabor atoms of free width (centre, frequency, width, cycles, amplitude, phase, R², onset and offset), and the global windows where any channel bursts.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run gabor_bursts --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run gabor_bursts --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run gabor_bursts --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --band "8-35 Hz" --from 0 --to 60
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |
| `bad` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "{recording}_bad_segments"}, required false | no |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording's name, or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `band` | `--band` | `8-35 Hz` | Hz |  | the frequencies searched (the reference detector's 8-35 Hz); the grid's frequencies reach one sigma_f past each edge, so a peak at an edge is told from a maximum |
| `sigma_min` | `--sigma-min` | `0.025` | s |  | the narrowest atom's width sigma (its envelope e^(-t^2/2 sigma^2); the reference detector's 25 ms) |
| `sigma_max` | `--sigma-max` | `0.64` | s |  | the widest atom's width sigma (the reference detector's 640 ms) |
| `per_octave` | `--per-octave` | `4` | widths/octave |  | widths an octave (the reference detector's 4) |
| `min_f_sigma` | `--min-f-sigma` | `0.5` | - |  | the smallest f x sigma of an atom (0.5: about 1.2 cycles at half maximum; the Gaussian kept off DC) |
| `tolerance` | `--tolerance` | `1e-06` | fraction |  | the share of the widest atom's response (L1) left outside the halo: the halo the chunks are read with |
| `decimation` | `--decimation` | `own` | - | own, none | own: each width at its own rate (every D-th sample, D the largest power of two keeping 3 samples a sigma; the reference detector's) \| none: every width at the recording's rate (for checks: memory as the full block) |
| `budget` | `--budget` | `1000000000` | bytes |  | the bytes one block of signal.gabor may hold; a larger one is refused before any data flows, with the remedy |
| `k` | `--k` | `4.0` | robust SD |  | robust SDs above each atom's median \|W\| over time for a candidate (the reference detector's 4) |
| `edge` | `--edge` | `0.5` | s |  | candidates within max(edge, 3 sigma) of the run's ends are left out (the reference detector's 0.5 s) |
| `steps` | `--steps` | `2` | rounds |  | the fit's rounds of the parabola in frequency and in log width (the reference detector's 2) |
| `min_cycles` | `--min-cycles` | `2.0` | cycles |  | a burst holds at least this many cycles at half maximum (the reference detector's mincyc 2) |
| `min_r2` | `--min-r2` | `0.7` | - |  | a burst is an atom whose R² against the band's signal in its half-maximum window is at least this (the reference detector's 0.7) |
| `r2_shape` | `--r2-shape` | `morlet_ladder` | - | morlet_ladder, meyer, morlet | the band's signal R² is measured against: morlet_ladder (the reference detector's: the squared gains of a Morlet ladder's members in the band) \| meyer (flat in the band, compact edges) \| morlet |
| `ladder_min` | `--ladder-min` | `1.0` | Hz |  | r2_shape morlet_ladder: the ladder's lowest centre (the reference detector's 1 Hz) |
| `ladder_max` | `--ladder-max` | `64.0` | Hz |  | r2_shape morlet_ladder: the ladder's highest centre (the reference detector's 64 Hz) |
| `ladder_voices` | `--ladder-voices` | `8` | voices/octave |  | r2_shape morlet_ladder: the ladder's members an octave (the reference detector's 8) |
| `edges` | `--edges` | `tangent` | - | tangent, half_max | the bursts' onset and offset: tangent (on the envelope at the burst's frequency, the reference detector's default) \| half_max (the atom's, t0 -/+ FWHM/2) |
| `envelope_window` | `--envelope-window` | `3.0` | s |  | tangent edges: the envelope is read over the burst's time -/+ max(this, 6 sigma) |
| `trough_reach` | `--trough-reach` | `1.0` | s |  | tangent edges: with no local minimum below half the peak, the trough is the lowest point within this of the peak |
| `overlap` | `--overlap` | `time_frequency` | - | time_frequency, time | the global windows: bursts joined where they overlap in time and frequency (f -/+ 1/(2 pi sigma)) \| in time alone |
| `bad_segments` | `--bad-segments` | `exclude` | - |  | exclude \| ignore the recording's bad spans (their frames NaN: left out of the atoms' levels and the peaks) |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| chunks over `recording` | [`signal.gabor`](../nodes.md) | x=recording, exclude=bad | band=$band, sigma_min=$sigma_min, sigma_max=$sigma_max, per_octave=$per_octave, min_f_sigma=$min_f_sigma, tolerance=$tolerance, decimation=$decimation, budget=$budget, bad_segments=$bad_segments | magnitude |
| chunks over `recording` | [`measurement.collect`](../nodes.md) | x=recording |  | series |
| chunks over `recording` | [`signal.band_filter`](../nodes.md) | x=recording | band=$band, shape=$r2_shape, ladder_min=$ladder_min, ladder_max=$ladder_max, voices=$ladder_voices | band_signal |
| chunks over `recording` | [`measurement.collect`](../nodes.md) | x=band_signal |  | band_series |
| after | [`measurement.summarize`](../nodes.md) | x=magnitude | summaries=["median", "mad"], combine=each | baseline |
| after | [`select.events.peaks`](../nodes.md) | x=magnitude, baseline=baseline | k=$k, edge=$edge | candidates |
| after | [`select.gabor_fit`](../nodes.md) | x=series, events=candidates, band=band_series | steps=$steps | atoms |
| after | [`select.events.spans`](../nodes.md) | events=candidates, x=atoms | rule=keep_where, where={"atom_width_peak": [1, null], "atom_cycles": ["$min_cycles", null], "atom_frequency": "$band"} | shaped |
| after | [`select.events.suppress`](../nodes.md) | events=shaped, x=atoms |  | merged |
| after | [`select.events.spans`](../nodes.md) | events=merged, x=atoms | rule=keep_where, where={"atom_r2": ["$min_r2", null]} | fitted |
| after | [`select.events.spans`](../nodes.md) | events=fitted, x=atoms, series=series | rule=edges, edges=$edges, envelope_window=$envelope_window, trough_reach=$trough_reach | bursts, burst_values |
| after | [`select.events.spans`](../nodes.md) | events=bursts, x=burst_values | rule=union, overlap=$overlap | windows |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `candidates` | kind spans, types ["atom"] |
| `atoms` | kind measurement, over candidates, of recording |
| `bursts` | kind spans, types ["burst"] |
| `burst_values` | kind measurement, over bursts, of recording |
| `windows` | kind spans, types ["window"] |

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE GABOR BURSTS of a recording: bursts in time, per channel, matched by unit-energy Gabor atoms of FREE width (spec docs/specs/2026-11-20-gabor-bursts.md). THE GRAPH:
  recording -- signal.gabor (|W| on every atom of the grid: widths sigma_min..sigma_max, per_octave a octave; at each width the band's frequencies in steps of sigma_f/2; EACH WIDTH AT ITS OWN RATE, one width at a
  time: a series per width on its own frames, every D-th sample, D the largest power of two keeping 3 samples a sigma) -- summarize --> each atom's own level (median and robust SD over its width's frames)
  -- select.events.peaks (local maxima in frequency x frame at each width, above median + k SD) --> the candidates -- select.gabor_fit (each candidate fitted on its channel's samples: t0, f, sigma, FWHM, cycles,
  amplitude, phase, |W|, the width test, R² against the band's signal) -- keep_where (a peak along width, at least min_cycles, f in the band) -- select.events.suppress (strongest first, within each
  atom's time and frequency resolution, across the widths) -- keep_where (R² >= min_r2) -- edges (tangent on the envelope | half_max) --> THE BURSTS, per channel, with their measures -- union --> THE GLOBAL WINDOWS.
Stored: the candidates and their atoms' measures, the bursts and their measures (with onset and offset), the global windows (each window's bursts recorded in its params).
MEMORY: one block holds channels x (the padded block x 8 + its spectrum x 16 bytes) and one width's |W| on the block's frames; it is checked against `budget` before any data flows (refused with the remedy).
The run holds each width's |W| over the span (about 31 MB a second of recording at 270 channels on the default grid, float32) and the span's samples twice (`collect`).

  nxr-neuro run gabor_bursts --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --band "8-35 Hz" --from 0 --to 60
```
